objective: Prevent misleading Seen-by-zero reports on newly sent Cluster Connect messages; display Sent until server-confirmed member room-read cursors cover a persisted message, protect read-marker writes from background and unfocused views, and prepare source-only consolidated RC inclusion.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: exact source baseline is the Nov12 consolidated RC draft head e01a35ed059647c0711ffb55b7349c0b83c2f6d6 (PR #743) fetched from authenticated GitHub before editing. This is a source comparison only. No installed-device or live production OTA readback has been performed; staging, production runtime and rollout remain unverified.
chosenApproach: Keep existing authorized scope-room cursor backend unchanged. Show a positive Seen label only if a persisted own message has an eligible non-sender reader timestamp, otherwise show Sent on the last bubble of a Cluster send group. Exclude pending/local/failed messages and block delayed read writes after navigation blur or app background. Retain existing Organization window grouping, direct chat, attachments, and content.
preserveBehaviors: Do not modify Supabase schema, member authorization, read RPC or RLS. Sender excluded from readers.
Do not alter Organization Connect reader window logic, direct chat read receipts or PTT/calling.
Do not modify video playback, photo uploads, navigation, ads, points, finance, offline queue or release configuration.
Do not claim room cursor timestamps as proof of per-message opening. Do not publish or promote production OTA in this workstream.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Only a focused Connect thread read-write visibility gate and outgoing bubble labels change, with pending and failed messages preserving their current send flow.
preservedBehaviors: No shared navigation, unrelated app state, media rendering or notification delivery is modified.
No read cursor writes are generated by the reader-list refresh RPC.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Cluster displays confirmed reader counts without the misleading empty report, and a read cursor cannot advance from an unfocused or backgrounded thread.
preservedBehaviors: Existing organization read-window grouping, direct Seen/Sent behavior, calls, PTT, scope membership and server read RPC remain intact.

acceptanceChecks: Tests assert no empty Seen report on own sends, positive Seen count, confirmed-delivery gate, sender exclusion and member-scoped cursor comparisons.
Tests assert no read-write while screen unfocused or backgrounded, including delayed scroll events.
Automated Engineering Accountability, Performance R1, Main Integration QA including TypeScript, and Android+Expo web compiled QA must pass at the exact frozen RC SHA before any OTA release decision.
Physical two-device Cluster send/read and production runtime checks are not verified here; no publish and no production success claim.
releaseState: DEV only; awaiting exact-source CI and consolidated RC inclusion. No OTA published.
